text:
maya: Quick check — final numbers for the weekly GPU capacity slide? I'm collating per-region runways for Friday. Can folks paste the current allocated GPU hours + runway in days. Need any immediate mitigations?

leo: US-WEST C1: allocated 6200 GPU-hours/week, avg util 84%, runway ~1.1 days at current burn. Preemptible pool unstable; spot reclaim rate 12% last 24h. Recommend throttling lower-priority batch by 30%.

vikram: APAC (sg, tok) combined: allocated 4800 GPU-hours/week, avg util 67%, runway ~3.6 days. Expect 25% uplift Mon-Wed due to marketing campaign. If uplift hits, we should fallback to eu-burst policy.

angela: EU clusters: allocated 3900 GPU-hours/week, avg util 79%, runway ~1.8 days. Observed packet loss spike on eu-agg last night causing ~8% request drop; network team is debugging. Throughput per-GPU dropped ~6% during the window, which effectively shaved runway by ~0.2 days.

samir: Cost note — if we trigger eu->us failover for 24h, estimated delta is +$5.6k due to cross-region egress + premium instance hours. Alternative: pin critical routes to dedicated capacity for 48h (adds ~$2.2k) — cheaper and lower risk.

leo: +1 for throttling non-critical batch. I can push a canary throttle to 30% now. Will monitor queue length.

autoscaler-bot: autoscaler event: scaled down sg-pool from 12->9 gpus at 2024-11-20T02:14Z due to lower sustained load. Recent scale-up attempts failed twice due to quota limit in apac-zone-2.

vikram: apac-zone-2 quota is still pending. I opened a ticket with cloud to request +5 GPUs; tracking ticket #CLD-1298. If we don't get quota, fallback to burst-north policy.

maya: Actions: leo apply throttle to non-critical batches (in progress), angela please escalate network packet loss root cause, samir prep cost delta slide with both failover and dedicated scenarios, vikram monitor quota ticket and confirm fallback routing. I'll include these in slide notes. :thumbsup:

angela: Escalation done — infra-networking assigned, will report within 2h.

leo: throttle applied, queue backpressure at 1.5x baseline but no dropped requests yet. Will update if degraded.

samir: cost slide draft attached to the weekly doc (link) — calls out +$5.6k cross-region vs +$2.2k dedicated. Also added a "degrade gracefully" option (reduce max seq len for non-critical jobs) which saves ~18% GPU-hours.

maya: Perfect. Last ask — any emergent risks that would flip recommendations before Friday? Speak now.

vikram: If cloud quota is denied and marketing uplift >20%, we should prepare emergency preemptible hotspot in us-east. Not ideal but buys 12-18h.

maya: ok. saving this thread into the deck notes. Thanks everyone.
